hypotheses.A0_trace_is_valid: Traced base logits agree with the independent checkpoint path to maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.A1_final_attention_repairs_wikitext: The pair-state router after Layer-11 attention improves WikiText fidelity by at least 0.10 over the boundary after Layer-10 MLP.
hypotheses.A2_attention_often_increases_readability: On every corpus, at least four attention stages improve fidelity by at least 0.02 over the preceding embedding/MLP boundary.
hypotheses.A3_mlp_often_increases_readability: On every corpus, at least four MLP stages improve fidelity by at least 0.02 over their same-layer post-attention boundary.
hypotheses.A4_both_operator_types_have_material_jum: On every corpus, attention and MLP each have at least one readability increase of 0.05.
hypotheses.A5_final_pre_mlp_state_is_universally_re: After Layer-11 attention, the frozen pair-state router reaches fidelity at least 0.70 and lies within 0.15 of rank-32 oracle on every corpus.
hypotheses.A6_half_block_profile_transfers_ood: The FineWeb stage-fidelity profile has Spearman correlation at least 0.70 with both OOD profiles.
